protocol: Second pass of the auditor-agreement sheet (audit_agree_sheet.py). After answering the first sheet, the person said that a fair number of "yes" answers were given when unsure. Same 60 cards, same crops (cut out of the first sheet's html), new order (random.Random(1106)), A1's answer still hidden, first-pass answers not shown. Five buttons: S "sure: yes, a <label>", A "unsure, could be a <label>", O "an animal, but not a <label>", N "not an animal", ? "can't tell at all". Scoring is fixed here, before the person sees the sheet (audit_agree_score.py --recheck): only S counts as yes; A is scored like ? (left out, and separately counted as disagreement with A1). The first pass stays on record as answered; both are reported.
